'''Ram α''' is a [[Common enemy]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Enemy description|The "Kriosson Anavon" (archive ID: ACL071α) is an energized variant of ACL071. The entity's excessive energy content gives it a characteristic bright red appearance and makes it stronger and faster than the standard variant.}}

==Overview==
A unique variant of [[Ram]], Rams α have similar appearance with their counterpart, but it doesn't make them more of the threat; Aside from a ram at front, which deals Physical damage, they can now perform a ground pound that deals Physical damage in an area.
